news.contents: San Francisco 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy completed 21 of 26 passes for 255 yards and three touchdowns in a 35-10 win against the Minnesota Vikings. Well then. Minnesota's defense entered tonight's game allowing the fewest points (16.1) and the second-fewest passing yards (170.6) per game, but it did not matter. Purdy was surgical, notching a second straight outing with three passing scores and at least a 79% completion rate. It was a masterful performance against a unit that'd given offenses...
news.title: Brock Purdy Near-Perfect in Convincing MNF Win

news.analysis: Gordon did the majority of his damage on the afternoon on one 24-yard run. He did not get many opportunities. He'll remain an RB2 play next week against the Jets.
news.contents: Ollie Gordon II ran for 69 yards on 11 carries in the Dolphins 26-9 loss on Sunday against the Bills. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for -2 yards receiving.
news.title: Ollie Gordon II runs for 69 yards Sunday

news.contents: Miami Dolphins running back Ollie Gordon II handled 11 carries for 69 yards in the team's 26-9 road loss to the Buffalo Bills. He also caught two passes for a loss of two yards (three targets). Gordon's highlight of the day was a 24-yard pickup in which he found a sliver of space to break through the line on a stretch play before rumbling over a defender or two downfield. It's another solid effort from the Oklahoma State product, though it won't make much of a dent for fantasy managers. Gordon...

news.analysis: This was not Skattebo's best performance, going for just 2.4 YPC and losing a fumble. If there is any solace, the Jags defensive front is one of the better units in the NFL, though that does little to comfort fantasy managers who started him.
news.contents: Cam Skattebo ran 14 times for 34 yards and caught three of seven targets for 14 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
news.title: Cam Skattebo contained in win over Jaguars

news.contents: New York Giants running back Cam Skattebo rushed 14 times for 34 yards (2.4 yards per carry) and lost a fumble in a 23-18 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars. Skattebo added three receptions (on seven targets) for 14 yards (4.7 yards per catch). He did not score a touchdown. Skattebo's fumble came in the third quarter, and it was returned 42 yards deep into New York territory, but it didn't end up costing the Giants, as the Jaguars eventually turned it over on downs. It was a frustrating day for ...
news.title: Cam Skattebo Inefficient But Continues to Dominate Touches

news.contents: Denver Broncos running back Jonah Coleman was a man who couldn't be kept out of the end zone on Sunday. The rookie back has been solid since returning in Week 7, but he was on another level this weekend. Coleman carried the ball 24 times for 111 yards and three touchdowns in the win over the Las Vegas Raiders. He also added four receptions for 18 yards through the air. Both the carries and the yardage are career highs for Coleman. He has run away with the lead back role in Denver, and he should...
news.title: Jonah Coleman Skyrockets his Stock After Three-Touchdown Performance

He was questionable to return, saying postgame that he was concerned when his knee buckled on a drive when Josh Allen threw an interception.
